mixedEnglish: Hiro missed a week of school, so he had to catch up with his classmates.
He borrowed their notes and studied every evening.
After two weeks, he understood the new lessons.
items.inferenceExplanation: 「missed a week of school」「borrowed their notes」「understood the new lessons」が手がかりです。欠席で生じた学習の遅れを勉強で埋めたので、catch upは「（遅れを）取り戻す」だと推測できます。
